description: This is an integration test Java class for testing loan approval amount modifications in the Apache Fineract project. It contains various test cases verifying the behavior of modifying approved loan amounts, including validation, event generation, disbursement effects, and history tracking.

classes.name: LoanModifyApprovedAmountTest
classes.description: This class contains multiple JUnit test cases to verify loan approved amount modification functionality, validation, event triggering, history tracking, disbursement interactions, and exceptional scenarios within the Fineract project.

methods.name: testValidLoanApprovedAmountModification
methods.description: Tests valid modification of the loan's approved amount and verifies the change details.

methods.name: testLoanApprovedAmountModificationEvent
methods.description: Verifies that changing the approved amount triggers the corresponding business event.

methods.name: testValidLoanApprovedAmountModificationInvalidRequest
methods.description: Ensures validation is enforced when null or invalid approved amount requests are made.

methods.name: testValidLoanApprovedAmountModificationInvalidLoanStatus
methods.description: Checks that approved amount modification fails if the loan is in an invalid status.

methods.name: testModifyLoanApprovedAmountTooHigh
methods.description: Tests the rejection when attempting to set approved amount above system maximum.

methods.name: testModifyLoanApprovedAmountHigherButInRange
methods.description: Checks adjusting approved amount within permissible range.

methods.name: testModifyLoanApprovedAmountWithNegativeAmount
methods.description: Validates that negative amounts are rejected.

methods.name: testModifyLoanApprovedAmountCapitalizedIncomeCountsAsPrincipal
methods.description: Tests interaction with capitalized income scenarios before approval amount modification.

methods.name: testModifyLoanApprovedAmountFutureExpectedDisbursementsCountAsPrincipal
methods.description: Verifies behavior when future expected disbursements are present.

methods.name: testModifyLoanApprovedAmountCreatesHistoryEntries
methods.description: Ensures history entries are correctly recorded upon each modification.

methods.name: testDisbursementValidationAfterApprovedAmountReduction
methods.description: Tests disbursement limits after reducing the approved amount.

methods.name: testProgressiveDisbursementsWithDynamicApprovedAmountChanges
methods.description: Validates multiple disbursements with changing approved amounts.

methods.name: testApprovedAmountModificationWithCapitalizedIncomeScenario
methods.description: Checks approved amount update logic when capitalized income is involved.

methods.name: testUndoDisbursementAfterApprovedAmountReduction
methods.description: Tests undoing disbursements after reducing approved amount.

methods.name: testUndoLastDisbursementWithMultipleDisbursements
methods.description: Tests undoing the most recent disbursement in a multi-disbursement scenario.

methods.name: testDisbursementValidationAfterUndoWithReducedApprovedAmount
methods.description: Verifies disbursement validation after undo and reduction of approved amount.

methods.name: testValidLoanAvailableDisbursementAmountModification
methods.description: Tests modification of the available disbursement amount.

methods.name: testLoanAvailableDisbursementAmountModificationEvent
methods.description: Verifies event trigger on modification of available disbursement amount.

methods.name: testValidLoanAvailableDisbursementAmountModificationInvalidRequest
methods.description: Enforces validation for bad requests on available disbursement amount modification.

methods.name: testValidLoanAvailableDisbursementAmountModificationInvalidLoanStatus
methods.description: Checks status restrictions on available disbursement amount modification.

methods.name: testModifyLoanAvailableDisbursementAmountHigherThanApprovedAmount
methods.description: Ensures exceeding the approved amount fails validation.

methods.name: testModifyLoanAvailableDisbursementAmountWithNegativeAmount
methods.description: Checks negative value rejection for available disbursement amount.

methods.name: testModifyLoanAvailableDisbursementAmountCapitalizedIncomeCountsAsPrincipal
methods.description: Tests interaction with capitalized income when modifying available amount.

methods.name: testModifyLoanAvailableDisbursementAmountFutureExpectedDisbursementsCountAsPrincipal
methods.description: Validates logic with future expected disbursements.

methods.name: testModifyLoanAvailableDisbursementAmountCreatesHistoryEntries
methods.description: Verifies history logging for available disbursement amount changes.
